title: [main] bug 652254 - Statutory Reporting Setup - new field for Official Name
summary: Czech statutory reporting now supports official company names up to 255 characters through a new Official Full Name field, with automatic migration from the legacy 30-character field and XML export updates.
key_points: New Official Full Name field (255 characters) added to Statutory Reporting Setup
Legacy Official Name field (30 characters) marked obsolete but retained for compatibility
VAT Statement, VAT Control Report, and VIES Declaration exports now use new field
Upgrade routine automatically copies existing Official Name values to new field
Per-company upgrade tag ensures migration runs only once
quote: Supporting an official name with up to 255 characters is an immediate legislative requirement for Czech statutory reporting.
